blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: On-device inference requires kernels that make effective use of local accelerators. Efficient training and evaluation of models that generate Apple Metal kernels benefit from native macOS tools and concurrent agent sessions. These sessions alternate between model requests, development commands, and GPU execution, leaving GPU capacity idle for much of a rollout. We present Metal Sandbox, infrastructure that combines restricted per-instance file access, native command execution, and command-level scheduling across interconnected Macs. Each agent retains its workspace and private development environment. Parallel commands can run concurrently, while serial commands share one execution slot per node; eligible waiting commands can migrate to available Macs and return results to the original agent. Integration with Harbor supports task execution, automatic verification, and rollout collection through a common workflow. Controlled experiments on four Mac mini M4 nodes achieve $1.68\times$--$2.05\times$ gains in command throughput under concentrated demand. Sixteen static agent traces give an estimated $2.14\times$ sustained-throughput gain for four sessions per node versus one, assuming continuously replenished sessions and unchanged mean durations. Replaying these measured traces under dynamic scheduling reduces mean tool waiting by 18.8% and batch elapsed time by 22.3%, assuming unchanged phase durations. Metal Sandbox and its Harbor integration are open-source on GitHub.
blocks.zh: On-device推论需要内核有效使用局部加速器. 对生成Apple Metal内核的模型进行有效的培训和评价,受益于本地的macOS工具和同时进行的代理课程。 这些会话在模型请求,开发命令,和GPU执行之间交替出现,使得GPU容量闲置,用于大部分推出. 我们介绍Metal Sandbox, 基础设施结合了限制的 per-Intance 文件访问, 本地命令执行, 以及命令级别列表 跨互连的Macs。 每个代理人保留其工作空间和私人发展环境。 并行命令可以同时运行,而串行命令每个节点共享一个执行槽;符合条件的等待命令可以迁移到可用的Macs,并将结果返回到原始代理. 与港湾的整合支持任务执行,自动核查,并通过共同的工作流程推出收集. 4个Mac迷你M4节点的受控实验在集中需求下实现了1.68\times$-2.05\times的指令吞吐量增益. 16个静态剂追踪估计每个节点可持续获得4.14美元的收益,假设连续补课,平均持续时间不变。 在动态调度中重放这些测量的痕迹,平均工具等待率减少18.8%,批量通过时间减少22.3%,假设阶段持续时间不变。 Metal Sandbox及其港湾集成在GitHub上的开源.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Efficient on-device inference requires kernels that use local accelerators well. Apple’s on-device foundation model illustrates this need for local inference optimization Gunter et al. (2024) . Metal provides a native GPU API and shading language for both M-series chips in Macs and A-series chips in iPhones Apple Inc. (2014) ; Apple Inc. (2026) . These processors combine high compute performance with energy-efficient designs Apple Inc. (2024a) ; Apple Inc. (2024b) ; unified memory also supports CPU/GPU workflows in frameworks such as MLX Hannun et al. (2023) . This combination makes Metal important for on-device computation. Improving models’ ability to generate efficient Metal kernels can support applications across Apple’s desktop and mobile devices.
blocks.zh: 高效的on-device推论需要内核能很好地使用局部加速器. 苹果公司的立体基础模型说明了本地推论优化Gunter等人(2024年)的这一需要. Metal为Macs中的M系列芯片和iPhones Apple Inc.(2014)中的A系列芯片提供本土GPU API和阴影语言;Apple Inc. (2026). 这些处理器将高计算性能与节能设计Apple Inc. (2024a) ; Apple Inc. (2024b) ; 统一的内存还支持了MLX Hannun等框架中的CPU/GPU工作流程(2023). 这种组合使得金属对于在设备上进行计算很重要. 提高模型生成高效金属内核的能力可以支持苹果公司的桌面和移动设备的应用.

blocks.en: Language models can generate and iteratively improve GPU kernels using compiler, correctness, and performance feedback. KernelBench provides evaluation tasks for CUDA and GPU-DSL generation Ouyang et al. (2025) . KernelGYM, introduced with Dr. Kernel , supplies distributed GPU evaluation and multi-turn data collection for reinforcement learning Liu et al. (2026) , while Metal-Sci studies automatic search over native Metal scientific kernels Gallego (2026) . Supporting broader Metal evaluation and training requires interactive agents to prepare dependencies, edit programs, compile candidates, and obtain feedback across concurrent rollouts.
blocks.zh: 语言模型可以使用编译器,正确性和性能反馈来生成并迭代地改进GPU内核. Kernel Bench为CUDA和GPU-DSL生成欧阳等人(2025年)提供评价任务. KernelGYM(由Kernel博士介绍),供应分发GPU评价和多回合数据收集,以进行强化学习;Liu等(2026年),而Metal-Sci研究自动搜索本土金属科学内核Gallego(2026年). 支持更广泛的金属评估和培训需要互动代理,以编制依赖性、编辑程序、编译候选人并获得同时推出的反馈。

blocks.en: These agents alternate between model requests, source editing, CPU preparation, and candidate execution. Figure 1 measures one metal_nbody session (task specification in Appendix D ) without competing agents. Apple Instruments’ Metal System Trace Apple Inc. (n.d.) records 44.0 seconds of GPU activity over 31.6 minutes, or 2.32% of the session. Most of the session is spent outside GPU execution. We therefore schedule individual commands across concurrent sessions to use idle GPU capacity, reduce tool waiting, and shorten rollout collection. Commands that run or time GPU work enter a serial queue on each Mac, while parallel commands, such as file inspection and editing, proceed without waiting for that queue. This allows commands to overlap while coordinating participating GPU timing commands. Per-node serialization alone, however, leaves queues unbalanced across Macs. In sixteen concurrent sessions on four Macs (Section 5.6 ), tool waiting accounts for 21.0 of the 45.1 minutes in an average session. Although each Mac hosts four sessions, sessions on the busiest Mac wait 32.7 minutes on average, compared with 13.3 minutes on the least busy Mac. Waiting serial commands can therefore migrate to Macs with free execution slots.
blocks.zh: 这些代理在模型请求,源编辑,CPU准备和候选执行之间交替. 图1测量一个金属-单体会话(附录D中的任务规格),没有相互竞争的代理人。 苹果仪器的金属系统追踪苹果公司(n.d.)记录了GPU活动超过31.6分的44.0秒,即会话的2.32%. 大部分会话都花费在GPU执行之外. 因此,我们将单个命令安排在并行的会话中,以使用闲置的GPU容量,减少工具等待,并缩短推出集. 运行或时间GPU工作的命令会在每个Mac上输入序列队列,而并行的命令,如文件检查和编辑,则不等待该队列而进行. 这允许命令在协调参与的GPU计时命令时重叠. 然而,单是节点序列化,就给Macs的队列留下了不平衡. 在四个Macs(第5.6节)同时举行的16场比赛中,工具等待占平均45.1分钟中的21.0分。 虽然每个Mac主机为四场会,但最繁忙的Mac的会场平均等待32.7分钟,而最不繁忙的Mac的会场平均等待13.3分钟. 因此,等待序列命令可以随自由执行槽迁移到Macs.

blocks.en: Concurrent development also requires separate instance files and a usable native tool environment. Agents need shell commands, compilers, and Metal programs without unrestricted write access to the host user’s files. Table 1 compares these environments. Docker containers and macOS VMs provide separate filesystems; bare macOS has no built-in file isolation between agent sessions. Standard Docker Desktop containers execute inside a Linux VM Docker Inc. (2024) , and Docker Desktop’s GPU support requires Windows with the WSL 2 backend Docker Inc. (2021) . macOS VMs provide a guest environment and virtual Metal graphics Apple Inc. (2022) . Bare macOS provides native execution, with file restrictions and timing coordination left to the application. KernelGYM already serializes evaluation tasks per GPU, but its evaluation backend targets CUDA Liu et al. (2026) . Interactive Metal rollouts additionally need persistent native workspaces and scheduling of individual tool commands.

KernelGYM已经将每个GPU的评价任务序列化,但其评价后端针对的是CUDA Liu等 (2026). 互动金属的推出还需要持续的本地工作空间和单个工具指令的时间安排。

blocks.en: We present Metal Sandbox , native execution infrastructure that combines restricted instance file access with command scheduling across interconnected Macs. Each agent receives an instance, a workspace, and a private development HOME . Commands run in Apple’s App Sandbox, an operating-system mechanism that restricts an application’s access to files and other resources Apple Inc. (2017) , with access to the instance’s files and required system tools. Our Harbor integration supports Claude Code, Codex, and mini-SWE-agent, enabling configured tasks, automatic verification, and trajectory collection through the same evaluation workflow Harbor contributors (2026) ; SWE-agent contributors (2026) .
blocks.zh: 我们介绍Metal Sandbox, 本地执行基础设施 结合限制实例文件访问 和命令调度 跨互连Macs。 每个代理人都得到一个实例、一个工作空间和一个私人发展家庭。 Apple's App Sandbox中运行的指令,这是一种操作系统机制,它限制应用程序访问文件和其它资源 Apple Inc. (2017),可以访问实例文件和所需的系统工具. 我们的港湾整合支持克洛德代码(Claude Codex)和小型SWE代理,允许配置任务,自动核查,通过相同的评价工作流程收集港湾贡献者(2026);SWE代理贡献者(2026).

blocks.en: The paper contributes: 1. A native multi-agent execution model with restricted per-instance file access, ordinary development commands, and per-node serial queues, integrated with Harbor for task execution and rollout collection. 2. Cross-Mac command migration that shares instance development files, coordinates execution at source and target nodes, and returns results to the original agent. 3. A four-Mac evaluation of cluster scaling, concentrated demand, and migration cost, plus scheduling replay that holds sixteen measured agent trajectories fixed.

blocks.en: 2 Native Execution and Instance Isolation
blocks.zh: 2 本土处决和隔离

blocks.en: 2.1 Native Command Interface
blocks.zh: 2.1 本地指令界面

blocks.en: An instance provides a workspace and development environment for an agent session, which repeatedly submits tool commands. Its owner node is the Mac hosting that session; an execution node is the Mac currently running one of its commands. During migration, the source node holds the waiting command, and the target node receives it. Each managed command includes the submitted program or shell expression and its child processes. The management service executes candidate builds and runs directly on host macOS in an App Sandbox process; ordinary child processes inherit its sandbox policy. Agents use native shell commands, installed compilers, SDKs, and Metal through this interface.
blocks.zh: 一个实例为代理会话提供了一个工作空间和发展环境,代理会话反复提交工具命令. 它的拥有者节点是该会话的Mac主机;一个执行节点是Mac目前运行它的命令之一. 在迁移期间,源节点持有等待命令,目标节点接收. 每个被管理的命令包括已提交的程序或 shell 表达式及其子进程. 管理服务在 App Sandbox 程序中执行候选人直接在主机macOS上构建和运行;普通的孩子进程继承了它的沙盒政策. 代理通过这个接口使用本地的 shell 命令,安装了编译器,SDKs,以及Metal.

blocks.en: 2.2 Instance Filesystem Isolation
blocks.zh: 2.2 实例文件系统隔离

blocks.en: The runtime maps HOME and shell ~ to the instance’s development directory and starts commands in its workspace. Agents can create and modify files in that workspace, private HOME , and temporary directories. Required system tools, SDKs, and configured development-tool directories remain accessible. Each sandbox process receives access to its own instance’s development files, without access to the host user’s entire home directory or other instances’ files.
blocks.zh: 运行时间将 Home 和 shell ~ 映射到实例的开发目录并开始在工作空间中命令 。 代理可以在此工作空间创建并修改文件,私人Home,以及临时目录. 所需的系统工具、SDK和已配置的开发工具目录仍然可以使用。 每个 sandbox 进程都可以访问自己实例的开发文件,不能访问主机用户的整个主目录或其他实例文件.

blocks.en: The following commands were executed in one instance using native /bin/sh and /bin/mkdir . The first creates a directory in the instance’s HOME ; the second attempts the same operation in the host user’s home.
blocks.zh: 以下命令在一次中使用了原生/bin/sh和/bin/mkdir执行. 第一个是创建一个目录,

blocks.en: $ mkdir ~/demo [ALLOWED; exit 0] $ mkdir /Users/sandbox1/demo [DENIED; exit 1] mkdir: /Users/sandbox1/demo: Operation not permitted
blocks.zh: $ mkdir ~/ demo [已关闭;退出] 0) mkdir/用户/sandbox1/demo [DENIED;出站口 1] mkdir:/用户/sandbox1/demo: 不允许操作

blocks.en: This per-instance filesystem isolation lets an agent edit, build, and test its own project while rejecting writes to host files outside the granted scope and to other instances’ workspaces.
blocks.zh: 这种逐个文件系统隔离让代理编辑、构建和测试自己的项目,同时拒绝写入给定范围以外的文件主机和其他实例的工作空间。

blocks.en: 2.3 Shared Files for Command Migration
blocks.zh: 2.3 用于命令迁移的共享文件

blocks.en: For dynamic scheduling, each instance uses its own shared workspace and development HOME , mounted at the same absolute paths on nodes in its scheduling pool. This makes the instance’s files available wherever its commands execute, while different instances retain separate directories. Temporary files, runtime binaries, and execution logs remain local. Identity markers detect shared directories that are missing, replaced, or mounted incorrectly. Toolchains, dependencies, and permissions must be compatible across nodes.
blocks.zh: 对于动态调度,每个实例都使用自己的共享工作空间和开发 Home ,安装在调度池节点上相同的绝对路径上。 这使得实例文件在其命令执行的地方都可以使用,而不同的实例则保留单独的目录. 临时文件,运行时间二进制,以及执行日志仍然是本地的. 身份标记检测丢失、替换或挂载错误的共享目录。 工具链、依赖性和权限必须相互兼容。

blocks.en: Migration starts a new process on the target node for a waiting command; it does not move a running process, live Metal buffers, or GPU state between Macs. Shared storage does not coordinate simultaneous writes by different commands. Commands that require local GUI state, sockets, running processes, unshared files, or device-specific state remain on their owner node.
blocks.zh: 迁移在目标节点启动等待命令的新进程;它不会在Macs之间移动运行的进程,活金属缓冲器,或GPU状态. 共享存储不协调不同命令同时写入 。 需要本地 GUI 状态、 套接字、 运行过程、 未共享文件或设备特定状态的命令仍然保留在其所有者节点上 。

blocks.en: 3 System Architecture
blocks.zh: 3 系统架构

blocks.en: Figure 2 shows how commands, results, and shared files move through the system. Figure 3 shows the four-Mac deployment, with Harbor and the cluster controller on the management node. The controller accepts cluster requests and records instance and command locations. Each node runs its own scheduler and sandbox processes, and checks saved execution state at startup to identify unfinished work left by an unexpected shutdown before accepting new work. Migrated commands execute through the target node’s normal management service.
blocks.zh: 图2显示命令、结果和共享文件如何通过系统移动。 图3显示四Mac的部署,管理节点上有港湾和集群控制器. 控制器接受集群请求并记录实例和命令位置. 每个节点运行自己的调度器和沙盒进程,并在启动时检查保存的执行状态,以识别在接受新工作前意外关闭而留下的未完成的工作. 通过目标节点的正常管理服务执行被忽略的命令 。

blocks.en: 3.1 Cross-Node Communication and Location Tracking
blocks.zh: 3.1 交叉节点通信和地点跟踪

blocks.en: When a request concerns another Mac (for example, placing an instance on a worker or migrating a waiting command), the cluster controller connects over SSH and invokes that node’s Metal Sandbox CLI. The remote service handles instance operations, file transfer, and execution-status queries; candidate commands run in its sandbox processes.
blocks.zh: 当请求涉及另一个Mac(例如,在工人身上设置实例或迁移等待命令)时,集群控制器在SSH上连接,并引用了该节点的Metal Sandbox CLI. 远程服务处理实例操作、文件传输和执行状态查询;候选命令在其沙盒进程中运行。

blocks.en: The controller records which node owns each instance and which node executes each command, together with migration progress. These records are saved to disk so later requests can find the same instance or command. For example, after a command migrates from Mac mini #B to #D, requests for its output are sent to #D while the agent remains on #B.
blocks.zh: 控制器记录每个实例的节点,以及执行每个命令的节点,同时记录迁移进度。 这些记录被保存到磁盘中,这样以后的请求就可以找到相同的实例或命令. 例如,一个命令从Mac minid #B迁移到#D后,当代理机留在#B时,其输出请求被发送到#D.

blocks.en: 3.2 Instance Placement
blocks.zh: 3.2 实例安置

blocks.en: For node n n , let A n A_{n} be the observed number of active instances and R n R_{n} the number of instances assigned there but still being created. Automatic placement selects from the eligible node set ℰ \mathcal{E} : n ∗ = arg ⁡ min n ∈ ℰ ⁡ ( A n + R n ) . n^{*}=\arg\min_{n\in\mathcal{E}}(A_{n}+R_{n}). (1) An eligible node must have a compatible service version, available instance capacity, no pending recovery, and a thermal state below critical. During batch creation, the controller updates the projected counts after each assignment so successive instances do not all use the same initial counts.

blocks.en: Instance count balances concurrent sessions but does not predict how much GPU work each session will submit. Command migration reduces queue imbalance that remains after instance placement.
blocks.zh: 实例计数平衡并行会话,但不预测每个会话会提交多少GPU工作. 命令迁移可以减少排队不平衡,而排队不平衡仍然是事后放置的.

blocks.en: 3.3 Per-Node Command Scheduling
blocks.zh: 3.3 节点指挥调度

blocks.en: The default allowlist includes common file and text commands, compilers, and build tools; Appendix C gives the complete list. Matching commands run in parallel; other commands enter the serial queue. The administrator can edit this list or use a blocklist, where matching commands run serially and others run in parallel. Rules match executable paths and argument prefixes, and supported shell expressions are inspected before scheduling. Rules cover a command and its child processes; they do not detect GPU calls. A build tool may launch GPU tests, so the administrator must classify that build command as serial when those tests require coordinated timing.
blocks.zh: 默认允许列表包括了常见的文件和文本命令,编译器,以及构建工具;附录C给出了完整的列表. 匹配命令平行运行;其他命令输入序列队列. 管理员可以编辑此列表或使用块列表,其中匹配命令按序运行,其他命令并行运行. 规则匹配可执行路径和参数前缀,支持的 shell 表达式会在调度前检查. 规则涵盖命令及其子进程;它们不检测GPU呼叫. 一个构建工具可能会启动GPU测试,因此当测试需要协调时间时,管理员必须将构建指令归类为序列.

blocks.en:
Each node has one serial execution slot and a first-in, first-out (FIFO) queue. Parallel commands can run while this slot is occupied. Queues are kept per node rather than cluster-wide. Each node admits its own serial commands without a round trip to the controller, so local scheduling adds no network latency and does not depend on controller availability. Cross-node balance is instead provided by migrating waiting commands (Section 3.4 ), at the cost of not enforcing a global arrival order.
Queue waiting is recorded separately and is excluded from Metal Sandbox’s managed command execution budget and Harbor’s active agent execution budget. The managed command’s execution budget starts when it receives execution permission.
blocks.zh:
每个节点有一个串行执行槽和一个先入先出(FIFO)队列. 并行命令可以在此槽被占用时运行. 队列按节点保存,而不是整组. 每个节点在不给控制器回程的情况下承认自己的串行命令,所以本地调度不增加网络时滞,也不取决于控制器的可用性. 交叉节点平衡则由迁移等待命令提供(第3.4节),其代价是不执行全球抵达命令。
队列等待被单独记录,并被排除在Metal Sandbox管理的指令执行预算和港港代理执行预算之外. 管理中的命令执行预算从它得到执行许可时开始 。

blocks.en: 3.4 Eligibility and Target-Node Selection
blocks.zh: 3.4 资格和目标点选择

blocks.en: Dynamic scheduling considers only waiting serial commands from instances that enable it and meet the shared-file requirements in Section 2.3 . The command’s arguments and environment must pass the source-private-path check; the target node also validates its files, environment, and scheduling rules. Parallel commands and agent sessions remain on their owner nodes. Intercepted shell tool calls supply their script, working directory, environment, relative timeout duration, and output-size limit. Calls missing this information remain local.
blocks.zh: 动态调度只考虑从允许它并且符合第 2.3 节中共享文件要求的例中等待序列命令. 命令的参数和环境必须通过源- 私通- 路径检查; 目标节点也验证其文件, 环境和调度规则 。 平行命令和代理会话仍保留在其主节点上. 被截取的 shell 工具调用提供他们的脚本,工作目录,环境,相对超时时间,以及输出大小限制. 失踪的电话仍为本地电话

blocks.en: The controller checks node status and looks for serial commands waiting at source nodes. A target node must have a free serial slot, no local serial waiters, no pending recovery, and a thermal state below critical. Among eligible remote nodes, the controller chooses the smallest active-instance count; equal counts are resolved by selecting the smallest node ID. Reservation then holds the target node’s slot so another command cannot take it before migration completes.
blocks.zh: 控制器检查节点状态并寻找在源节点等待的序列命令. 一个目标节点必须有一个自由的序列槽,没有本地的序列服务员,没有等待恢复,并且处于临界值以下的热能状态. 在符合条件的远程节点中,控制器选择最小的活性-静脉计数;等数通过选择最小的节点ID来解决. 然后保留目标节点的空档, 这样另一个命令在迁移完成前无法使用 。

blocks.en: 3.5 Scheduling Pools
blocks.zh: 3.5 时间安排池

blocks.en: The administrator assigns each node to a scheduling pool , for example to group Macs with compatible hardware and toolchains. Automatic instance placement can be restricted to a selected pool. Command migration stays within the source node’s pool and requires cross-node scheduling to be enabled on both source and target nodes.
blocks.zh: 管理员将每个节点分配到一个调度池,例如,将具有相容硬件和工具链的Mac分组. 自动实例放置可限制在选定的池中 。 指令迁移停留在源节点的池内,需要启用源和目标节点的交叉节点调度.

blocks.en: 3.6 Reservation, Claim, and Commit
blocks.zh: 3.6 保留、主张和提交

blocks.en: Figure 4 shows how a waiting command moves from its source queue to execution on a target node through reservation, claim, and commit. Reservation checks the shared workspace, command, environment, and scheduling rules, then holds the target node’s serial slot and prepares its sandbox process. The controller saves the command ID, source node, target node, and migration progress. Claim transfers execution responsibility from the source queue to the target reservation, disabling a local start. Commit authorizes the reserved command to start on the target node.
blocks.zh: 图4显示等待命令如何通过保留、主张和承诺从源队列到目标节点的执行。 保留检查共享的工作空间、命令、环境和排程规则,然后保留目标节点的序列档并准备其沙盒过程。 控制器会保存命令ID,源节点,目标节点,以及迁移进度. 要求将执行责任从源队列转移到目标保留地,使本地启动失效. 提交授权保留命令开始目标节点 。

blocks.en: If the source command has already started or been cancelled, claim fails and the controller releases the unused target reservation. If the source node accepted the claim but its response was lost, the controller queries the same command ID before proceeding. It then commits the reserved command to the target node, which checks the command description and reservation ID. The target node records the command as queued, then running when execution starts.
blocks.zh: 如果源指令已经启动或被取消,则索赔失败,控制器会释放未使用的目标保留. 如果来源节点接受索赔要求,但其答复被丢失,控制员在进行诉讼前会询问同一命令ID。 它然后将保留的命令承诺给目标节点,该节点检查命令描述和保留ID. 目标节点将命令记录为队列,然后在执行开始时运行.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Command migration through reservation, claim, and commit. The source-node claim prevents local execution before the target node starts the command.
blocks.zh: 图4:通过保留、主张和承诺来指挥移徙。 源节点的声称在目标节点启动命令前阻止了本地执行.

blocks.en: 3.7 Results and Accounting
blocks.zh: 3.7 成果和会计

blocks.en: The target node returns stdout, stderr, exit status, and cleanup information using the migrated command’s ID. The source node uses these results to finish the original CLI execution or shell tool call. Execution logs and local temporary files stay on the target node; workspace modifications are visible through shared storage.
blocks.zh: 目标节点返回 stdout, stderr, 退出状态, 并使用迁移命令的ID进行清理 。 源节点使用这些结果来完成最初的CLI执行或 shell工具调用. 执行日志和本地临时文件保留在目标节点上;工作空间修改通过共享存储可见.

blocks.en: The command remains attributed to its owner instance, while per-node execution counts record where it actually runs. Batch elapsed time is measured at the submitting controller. The controlled experiments report queue waiting at both nodes; the agent traces report the broader submission-to-start interval defined in Section 5.6 .
blocks.zh: 该命令仍归结于其所有者实例,而每个节点执行记录其实际运行地点. 批次通过时间由提交控制器测量 。 受控实验报告在两个节点等待的队列;代理跟踪报告第5.6节所定义的更广泛的提交-启动间隔.

blocks.en: 4 Harbor Integration
blocks.zh: 4 港口一体化

blocks.en: Harbor connects task specifications, coding agents, and automatic verification through the Metal Sandbox environment adapter. For each trial, the adapter creates an instance, uploads the task files, prepares the agent runtime within the instance, and starts the configured harness. The agent and verifier use separate execution phases; the verifier receives the completed workspace and returns the task result. Harbor retains these results and the agent trajectory for evaluation and rollout collection.
blocks.zh: 港口通过金属沙盒环境适配器连接任务规格,编码剂,以及自动验证. 对于每次试验,适配器都会创建一个实例,上传任务文件,在实例中准备代理运行时间,并启动所配置的抓取. 代理人和核查人使用单独的执行阶段;核查人接收已完成的工作空间并返回任务结果. 港口保留了这些结果和用于评价和推广收集的代理人轨迹。

blocks.en: Claude Code, Codex, and mini-SWE-agent are supported through the same managed command interface. Claude Code and Codex use tool hooks to route shell commands through the sandbox command helper. mini-SWE-agent uses its MetalEnvironment interface to submit commands and receive their outputs. Agent sessions run concurrently, and each tool call is scheduled independently. A migrated call retains its shell script, working directory, environment, and original result interface. Calls that lack a shared-workspace description remain on the owner node.
blocks.zh: Claude Code, Codex, 和迷你-SWE-agent 通过相同的管理指令界面支持. Claude Code和Codex使用工具钩来通过沙盒命令帮助器路由 shell 命令. 微型SWE代理公司使用其金属环境接口提交命令并接收其产出。 代理会话同时运行,每个工具呼叫都是独立安排的. 一个已迁移的调用保留了它的 shell 脚本,工作目录,环境和原始结果接口. 要求所有者节点上仍没有共享工作空间描述。

blocks.en: Harbor task configuration selects the harness and runtime version, model endpoint, concurrency, and execution budgets. The adapter records command waiting separately from active execution, preserves stdout, stderr, and exit status, and collects the native trajectory and standardized ATIF record. This allows rollout timing to distinguish model requests, tool execution, and tool waiting.
blocks.zh: 港站任务配置选择了套接字和运行时间版本,模式端点,通货和执行预算. 适配器记录命令与活性执行分开等待,保存了stdout,stderr,和退出状态,并收集了原生轨迹和标准化的ATIF记录. 这使得推出时间可以区分模型请求,工具执行,工具等待.

blocks.en: 5 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5. 评价

blocks.en: We measure command throughput, scaling with node count, and queue waiting under balanced and concentrated submissions, then examine longer commands and migration overhead. The controlled experiments use fixed Metal implementations. Section 5.6 reports all sixteen measured static agent trajectories; Section 5.7 replays those fixed traces under dynamic scheduling.
blocks.zh: 我们测量命令的吞吐量,以节点计数的缩放,排队等待均衡而集中的提交,然后检查更长的命令和迁移的起伏. 受控实验采用固定的金属执行. 第5.6节报告所有16个测量到的静态剂轨迹;第5.7节在动态调度下重放这些固定的痕迹.

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup and Workloads
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置和工作量

blocks.en: We use fixed workloads to measure how command scheduling changes throughput and waiting as demand and node count vary. The experiments use four Mac mini nodes with Apple M4 processors, 32 GiB memory per node, and macOS 27.0.1 (build 26A434), interconnected through a gigabit Ethernet switch. Two owner instances are prepared per node. Shared workspaces use SMB mounts at matching absolute paths, and control requests use the remote CLI over SSH.
blocks.zh: 我们使用固定的工作量来衡量指令调度改变吞吐量和等待需求与节点计数的变化. 实验使用四个带有Apple M4处理器的Mac迷你节点,每个节点32个GiB内存,和macOS 27.0.1 (built 26A434),通过千兆以太网开关连接. 每个节点准备两个所有者实例。 共享的工作空间在匹配绝对路径时使用SMB挂载,控制请求使用远程CLI来覆盖SSH.

blocks.en: Table 2 lists the six hand-written Metal kernels. Inputs are deterministic float32 arrays, with a i = ( ( i mod 23 ) − 11 ) / 16 a_{i}=((i\bmod 23)-11)/16 and b i = ( ( i mod 17 ) − 8 ) / 16 b_{i}=((i\bmod 17)-8)/16 . The matrix and convolution workloads use these values in their respective shapes.
blocks.zh: 表2列出了6个手写金属内核. 输入为定型活浮32阵列,有a = ((i mod 23)-11) / 16 a_{i}= ((i\bmod 23)-11)/16和b i = (i mod 17)-8) / 16 b_{i}= ((i\bmod 17)-8)/16. 矩阵和演化工作量分别使用这些值的形状.

blocks.en: Table 2: Fixed scheduling workloads. TG denotes the requested threads per threadgroup, bounded by the pipeline limit.
blocks.zh: 表2:固定时间安排工作量。 TG 表示每个线组请求的线程,以管道限制为界.

blocks.en: An Objective-C++ runner is compiled with -O2 before the measured batches. Each command loads and compiles the Metal source, creates its pipeline and buffers, and repeatedly submits the selected kernel. Every submission is followed by waitUntilCompleted() , which waits for the GPU command buffer to finish before its GPU start and end timestamps are read. Five submissions warm up execution, followed by at least thirty valid GPU timestamp samples. The loop repeats submissions until the elapsed time from its start reaches the requested minimum of two or six seconds, including encoding, submission, and waiting. We call these workloads two-second and six-second commands, respectively. Both use the same small input shapes.
blocks.zh: 目标-C++跑道在所测批次前用-O2来编译. 每个命令会加载并编译出Metal源,创建其管道和缓冲器,并反复提交所选内核. 每次提交后都会有waitUntilConfleted () , 等待 GPU 命令缓冲器在读取其 GPU 开始和结束时间戳之前完成 。 5份呈文加热了执行过程,随后至少有30个有效的GPU时间戳样本. 环路重复提交,直到从开始到结束的时间达到所要求的最少2至6秒,包括编码、提交和等待。 我们称这些工作量分别为2秒和6秒。 两者都使用相同的小输入形状.

blocks.en: The runner writes each result for an external correctness check. Command outputs are checked before they contribute to the reported throughput.
blocks.zh: 跑者为外部正确性检查写每个结果 。 命令产出在增加所报的吞吐量之前要加以检查。

blocks.en: 5.2 Baselines and Comparison Design
blocks.zh: 5.2 基线和比较设计

blocks.en: The comparison holds the controller build, Metal implementations, participating machines, workload commands, runner, shared storage, scheduling rules, and numerical checker constant. We compare: 1. Static scheduling: commands execute on their assigned owner nodes, with cross-node command migration disabled. 2. Dynamic scheduling: eligible waiting serial commands can migrate to available target nodes through the reservation–claim–commit protocol. Owner assignments are controlled explicitly. Balanced batches distribute commands round-robin across the selected nodes; concentrated batches submit all commands through two instances on the management node. All workload commands use the serial queue, allowing one workload command per node at a time.
blocks.zh: 比较显示控制器构建、金属执行、参与机器、工作量命令、跑道、共享存储、调度规则和数字检查器常数。 我们比较: 1. 静态调度:命令在指定的所有者节点上执行,而交叉节点命令迁移被禁用. 2. 动态调度:符合条件的等待序列命令可以通过保留-声明-承诺协议迁移到可用的目标节点. 所有者转让受到明确的控制。 平衡分批在所选节点之间分配回旋命令;集中分批通过管理节点上的两个实例提交所有命令. 所有工作量命令都使用序列队列,允许每次每个节点一个工作量命令.

blocks.en: Static scheduling: commands execute on their assigned owner nodes, with cross-node command migration disabled.
blocks.zh: 静态调度:命令在指定的所有者节点上执行,并禁用交叉节点命令迁移.

blocks.en: Dynamic scheduling: eligible waiting serial commands can migrate to available target nodes through the reservation–claim–commit protocol.
blocks.zh: 动态调度:符合条件的等待序列命令可以通过保留-声明-承诺协议迁移到可用的目标节点.

blocks.en: Batch time is measured on the submitting controller from submission through completion of all result reads and external numerical checks. Runner compilation and reference-output preparation precede that interval; per-command Metal compilation and pipeline creation occur inside it. Throughput is the completed command count divided by batch time, expressed as commands per hour. Configuration order is randomized within each repetition. We report medians and observed minimum–maximum ranges over three independent batches per configuration.
blocks.zh: 对提交控制器从提交到完成所有结果读取和外部数字检查的批量时间进行测量。 运行器编译和参考产出编制在此间隔之前;每个指令金属编译和管道的创建都发生在其中。 通量是完成的命令数除以批量时间,以时速命令表示. 配置顺序在每次重复中随机进行. 我们报告每个配置三个独立批次的中位数和观察到的最小-最大范围。

blocks.en: 5.3 Throughput, Scaling, and Queue Delay
blocks.zh: 5.3 流量、缩放和队列延迟

blocks.en: We first measure throughput, scaling, and queue delay using twelve commands per batch, with each of the six kernels executed twice and a two-second minimum computation loop. Balanced submissions use one, two, or four nodes; concentrated submissions use the four-node cluster.
blocks.zh: 我们首先使用每批12个命令来测量吞吐量,缩放和队列延迟,6个内核中的每个都执行过两次并有一个2秒最小的计算回路. 均衡提交使用一、二或四个节点;集中提交使用四个节点组。

blocks.en: Table 3 reports batch times and throughput. Balanced static execution decreases from 25.2 seconds on one node to 6.62 seconds on four nodes. With dynamic scheduling enabled, balanced runs take 25.1, 12.8, and 6.61 seconds on one, two, and four nodes. No commands migrate in these balanced batches, so the improvement comes from parallel execution across the available nodes.
blocks.zh: 表3报告批量时间和吞吐量。 平衡静态执行从一个节点的25.2秒减少到四个节点的6.62秒. 启用动态调度后,平衡运行需要25.1,12,8和一,二,四个节点的6.61秒. 在这些平衡批次中,没有命令迁移,因此改进来自跨可用节点的并行执行.

blocks.en: Table 3: Twelve commands per batch with two-second minimum computation-loop durations. Times are medians [minimum, maximum] over three independent batches. Throughput is the median number of commands per hour calculated from each batch. All 288 reported executions pass the numerical check.
blocks.zh: 表3:每批12个命令,最低计算周期为2秒。 时间是三个独立批次的中位数[最小,最大]. 通量是从每批量计算出的时速指令中位数. 所有288起死刑报告都通过数字核对。

blocks.en: Figure 5: Concentrated submission to one node in a four-Mac cluster. Panel (a) shows batch time for two-second loops with twelve commands and six-second loops with six commands. Panel (b) shows within-batch queue p95 for the two-second workload. Bars show medians and whiskers show the minimum–maximum range of three independent batches.
blocks.zh: 图5:集中提交四磁星组中的一个节点。 面板 (a) 显示有12个指令的2秒循环和有6个指令的6秒循环的分批时间。 面板(b)显示两秒工作量的批内队列p95。 边框显示中位数和胡子显示三个独立批次的最小最大范围。

blocks.en: With concentrated submissions on the four-node cluster, median batch time decreases from 25.3 to 15.1 seconds, a 40.4% reduction and 1.68 × \times throughput gain. The controller initiates at most one migration per source node per scan and prepares remote execution through synchronous control requests, while the source queue continues executing locally. This limits how quickly the three remote serial slots can be filled for approximately two-second commands. Recorded GPU device identities show per-node command counts of 7/3/1/1, 7/3/1/1, and 6/3/2/1 across the three dynamic batches. Six or seven commands therefore still execute serially on the source node, compared with three per node in the balanced case. At approximately 2.10 seconds per command, this remaining source-node work accounts for approximately 12.6–14.7 seconds of execution. The remaining concentration, together with remote preparation and control costs, limits the speedup below balanced four-node scaling.
blocks.zh: 由于提交材料集中在四个节点集群上,中间批量时间从25.3秒减少到15.1秒,减少40.4%,增加1.68分; 控制器每扫描一次最多启动一个源节点的迁移,并通过同步控制请求准备远程执行,而源队列继续本地执行. 这限制了3个远程序列槽能够被填补大约2秒的命令的速度. 所记录的GPU设备身份显示,在三个动态批次中,每个节点的指令计数分别为7/3/1/1、7/3/1/1和6/3/2/1。 因此,在源节点上仍然有6个或7个命令连续执行,而平衡中每个节点执行3个. 按每个命令大约2.10秒计算,其余的源点工作大约为12.6至14.7秒。 剩余的集中,加上远程制备和控制成本,将速度限制在平衡的四节点缩放下.

blocks.en: The runtime’s queueWaitSeconds adds queue waiting at the source and target nodes. We compute the linearly interpolated 95th percentile within each twelve-command batch. Under concentrated submissions, the median of these batch values decreases from 21.9 [21.8, 21.9] seconds to 11.9 [10.5, 12.9] seconds, a 45.5% reduction (Figure 5 b).
blocks.zh: 运行时间的队列 Waitseconds 添加了在源头和目标节点等待的队列. 我们计算每批12个指令中线性插值的95%。 在集中提交材料中,这些批量值的中位数从21.9分秒[21.8,21.9]降至11.9分秒[105,12.9],下降45.5%(图5b)。

blocks.en: 5.4 Long-Command Scheduling
blocks.zh: 5.4 长征日程安排

blocks.en: To examine longer commands, we increase the minimum computation-loop duration to six seconds and submit each of the six kernels once per batch, using the same submission setup as the concentrated two-second batches.
blocks.zh: 为了检查更长的指令,我们把最小计算-启动时间增加到6秒,每批提交6个内核中每个内核一次,使用与集中的2秒分的提交设置相同.

blocks.en: Static execution takes 36.8 [36.7, 36.8] seconds per batch, while dynamic scheduling takes 18.0 [17.6, 18.2] seconds (Figure 5 a). This gives a 51.1% reduction in median batch time and 2.05 × \times throughput: 588 versus 1,200 commands per hour. Four of the six commands execute on other nodes in every dynamic batch.

blocks.en: We perform 27 explicit command migrations from the management node to one worker, with three repetitions for each combination of payload read size (0, 1, or 16 MiB) and minimum computation-loop duration (0, 0.25, or 2 seconds). blocks.en: 5.7 Trace-Driven Scheduling Replay
blocks.zh: 5.7 跟踪驱动排程重放

blocks.en:
Independent live runs can produce different model responses, command sequences, compilation failures, and execution durations. Comparing a live static run with a separate dynamic run would mix the scheduling effect with changes in agent behavior.
We therefore use paired trace-driven replay to compare both scheduling policies on the same measured trajectories.
The measured static instances use local workspaces. In the replay, recorded command paths are screened according to the migration-eligibility requirements in Section 3.4 . With static scheduling, each replayed session finishes less than 1 ms from its measured finish time, and its total tool waiting differs by less than 8 ms. This validates the reconstruction of the recorded schedule before changing the policy.

独立活跑可以产生不同的模型响应,命令序列,编译失败,以及执行期限. 将活的静态运行和单独的动态运行相比较,会将调度效应与代理行为的变化相混合.
因此,我们使用对等的微量驱动回放来比较在同一个测量轨迹上的两种调度政策.
测量到的静态实例使用本地工作空间. 在重播中,根据3.4节中的迁移资格要求筛选已记录的命令路径. 通过静态调度,每一次重播会话完成所测量的结束时间不到1 ms,其总工具等待时间相差不到8 ms. 这证实了在改变政策之前对记录时间表的重建。

blocks.en: 6 Related Work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en: KernelBench couples correctness and performance evaluation with parallel generation and serialized GPU execution Ouyang et al. (2025) . KernelGYM, developed for Dr. Kernel , supports distributed GPU evaluation, isolated subprocesses, and multi-turn reinforcement-learning data collection Liu et al. (2026) . Metal-Sci searches native Metal scientific kernels Gallego (2026) , while KernelArc coordinates optimization agents and shares validated results Kundu et al. (2026) . These systems schedule work at the granularity of candidate evaluations. Metal Sandbox schedules the individual tool commands of interactive agent sessions, which run in persistent native macOS instances with direct Apple GPU access.

blocks.en: distcc distributes compilation by sending preprocessed sources and compiler arguments Pool (2008) . Bazel Remote Execution distributes build and test actions through a worker pool, transferring inputs and caching outputs in content-addressed storage Bazel contributors (2018) . These systems establish command-level remote execution. Metal Sandbox supports interactive tools in persistent native macOS instances, sharing workspace and HOME paths while preserving each agent’s command-result interface.

blocks.en: Sparrow delays task assignment until workers are ready to execute Ousterhout et al. (2013) . Work stealing lets idle processors take ready computations from other processors Blumofe and Leiserson (1999) . Metal Sandbox applies availability-based scheduling to waiting serial tool commands, using target reservations and source claims to coordinate migration while running processes remain local.

(2025) , and R2E-Gym provides executable software-engineering environments and hybrid verification Jain et al. (2025) . Metal Sandbox supplies native Apple Metal execution and command scheduling through Harbor, supporting Claude Code, Codex, and mini-SWE-agent in a common task and trajectory-collection workflow.

blocks.en: 7 Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 讨论和限制

blocks.en: File-access restrictions apply to sandbox processes and their ordinary children; some application-launch paths remain outside this boundary. The system does not provide hostile multi-tenant containment or physical GPU exclusivity. Other applications and commands classified as parallel may still use the GPU.
blocks.zh: 文件访问限制适用于沙盒过程及其普通子孙;一些应用-启动路径仍然停留在这个边界外. 该系统不提供敌对的多租户限制或物理GPU排他性。 其他被归类为平行的应用程序和命令可能仍然使用GPU.

blocks.en: Replay estimates scheduling effects while holding model behavior and phase durations fixed. It uses a source-notification delay estimated from the sandbox-process polling interval. It cannot predict changes in agent behavior caused by different tool feedback, or changes in kernel quality, training outcomes, or deployment reliability. Eight trajectories have less accumulated tool waiting and eight have more, even though mean tool waiting and batch elapsed time improve.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: Metal Sandbox combines native Apple Metal execution, per-instance filesystem isolation, and command-level scheduling across interconnected Macs. Its Harbor integration supports Claude Code, Codex, and mini-SWE-agent through a shared task, verification, and trajectory-collection workflow. Four-node experiments demonstrate scaling under balanced submissions and throughput gains under concentrated submissions. Replaying fixed agent trajectories predicts reduced tool waiting and shorter batch completion under dynamic scheduling. Metal Sandbox provides execution infrastructure for training and evaluating models that generate Apple Metal kernels.
blocks.zh: Metal Sandbox结合了原生的Apple Metal执行,per-intance文件系统隔离,以及命令级别跨互联Macs的调度. 它的港湾集成通过共同的任务,核查,以及轨迹收集工作流程,支持克洛德代码,Codex,以及小型SWE代理. 4个节点的实验表明,在均衡提交材料中缩小了规模,在集中提交材料中增加了吞吐量。 重放固定代理轨迹预测工具等待量会减少,在动态调度下批量完成会缩短. Metal Sandbox提供执行基础设施,用于培训和评价生成Apple Metal内核的模型.

blocks.en: Inputs contain 1,275 complete model phases, 1,279 tool calls (1,165 serial and 114 parallel), and 144 setup or verification commands. All 1,274 tools with execution-start records have matching command-argument hashes. Responses, command order, observed execution-slot occupancy, and local communication durations remain fixed. Each subsequent model request, tool call, verification step, or shutdown is delayed until its preceding responses are available. Tool waiting ends at the source start notification, which may arrive after remote execution begins.
blocks.zh: 输入包含1,275个完整的模型阶段,1,279个工具呼叫(1,165个序列和114个平行),144个设置或验证命令. 所有带有执行启动记录的1,274个工具都有相匹配的命令-参数散列. 答复、命令、观察的行刑地点占用和当地通信时间仍然固定。 其后的每个模型请求、工具呼叫、核查步骤或关闭都被推迟,直到有先前的答复。 工具等待结束在源头开始通知,在远程执行开始后可能到达.

blocks.en: Each node has one serial execution slot and a first-in, first-out (FIFO) queue. Every second, the controller checks source nodes in node-ID order. A target node must have a free serial slot and no local waiting serial commands; selection uses current instance count, then node ID. Waiting commands are selected by command-ID order, without inspecting future durations. Reservation occupies the target slot; a source-local start before claim cancels migration. Commands already running are not migrated; agent sessions, parallel tools, setup, and verification remain on their owner nodes.
blocks.zh: 每个节点有一个串行执行槽和一个先入先出(FIFO)队列. 每秒,控制器都会按节点-ID顺序检查源节点. 一个目标节点必须有一个自由的序列槽,没有本地的等待序列命令;选择使用当前实例计数,然后是节点ID. 等待命令由命令-ID命令选择,而不检查未来的持续时间. 保留占用了目标位置;在取消迁移之前先从源地开始。 已经运行的命令不会迁移;代理会话、并行工具、设置和校验仍然保留在其主节点上。

blocks.en: The replay filters the recorded command text for absolute paths to owner-local files, leaving 1,131 serial tools eligible for migration. Environment-variable references to node-private dependencies require portable environments for these predictions.
blocks.zh: 重放会过滤录入的命令文本以获取所有者-本地文件的绝对路径,留下1131个序列工具符合迁移条件. 环境可变性地提及节点-私人依赖性需要便携式环境来进行这些预测。

blocks.en: The 27 measured migrations provide median combined lookup and reservation, claim, and commit delays of 0.818, 0.00097, and 0.00389 seconds. A further 0.935 seconds is the median difference between remote-result observation time and candidate-process execution time; it includes cleanup, communication, and result polling. Source notification adds an estimated 0.015 seconds, half the configured 0.030-second sandbox-process polling interval. The main replay uses overhead scale 1, controller start offset 0, and command-ID ordering seed 0.
blocks.zh: 27次测量的移徙提供了中位数的检查和保留、索赔,并造成0.818、0.00097和0.00389秒的延误。 另外0.935秒是远程结果观察时间与候选人程序执行时间之间的中位相差;它包括清理、通信和结果投票。 来源通知估计增加了0.015秒,是所配置的0.030秒沙盒-进程投票间隔的一半。 主回放使用自控比例 1,控制器开始抵消0,命令ID命令种子0.

blocks.en: With static scheduling, each replayed session finishes less than 1 ms from its measured finish time, and its total tool waiting differs by less than 8 ms. Validation also checks phase dependencies and durations, keeps parallel commands local, and enforces migration eligibility, one serial command per node, target reservations, and selection based only on current node status. The sensitivity study combines four migration-cost scales {0.5,1,2,4}, four controller start offsets {0,0.25,0.5,0.75} seconds, and ten command-ID ordering seeds 0–9, giving 4 × 4 × 10 = 160 4\times 4\times 10=160 configurations. Six additional configurations vary only source-notification delay {0,0.03,0.1,0.5} seconds or controller-check interval {2,5} seconds from the main settings. All 166 pass the scheduling checks. Mean tool waiting spans 16.7–19.6 minutes; batch elapsed time spans 48.8–57.1 minutes. All configurations and trajectories are retained in the artifact.
blocks.zh: 通过静态调度,每一次重播会话完成所测量的结束时间不到1 ms,其总工具等待时间相差不到8 ms. 验证还检查相位依赖性和持续时间,保持平行命令局部,并强制执行迁移资格,每个节点一个序列命令,目标保留,以及仅根据当前节点状态进行选择. 灵敏度研究结合了四个迁移成本尺度{0.5,1,2,4},四个控制器开始抵消了{0,0.25,0.5,0.75}秒,十个命令ID点出0-9种子,给出4×4×10=160 4\times 4\times 10=160配置. 6个附加的配置仅从主设置中变化出出源通知延迟{0,0.03,0,0.5}秒或控制器-检查间隔{2,5}秒. 所有166人通过日程安排检查。 平均工具等待时间为16.7至19.6分;批次通过时间为48.8至57.1分。 所有布局和轨迹都保留在文物中.

blocks.en: This is a complete project task to be completed autonomously. You receive the full specification and public attachments at the start. Implement, build, test, and fix the project within the same session without waiting for clarification, approval, or further evaluation feedback. Decide unspecified details yourself and document them in the README. Tool calls are unlimited. Submit complete source code, dependency configuration, a launch entry point, and usage instructions; do not submit plans, placeholder modules, or unfinished implementations. The project is frozen after final submission or the time limit and evaluated centrally, without returning errors for further repair. Interactions described below are features of the finished product and do not require user participation during development.
blocks.zh: 这是需要自主完成的完整项目任务。 你收到完整的规格和公开附件 在同一会期内实施、建设、测试和确定项目,无需等待澄清、批准或进一步评价反馈。 自行决定具体细节, 并在 README 中记录 。 工具呼叫是无限的. 提交完整的源代码,依赖配置,发射入口,以及使用指令;不提交计划,占位模块,或未完成的执行. 项目在最后提交或时限后被冻结,并集中评估,不得退回错误供进一步修复。 下文所述的相互作用是成品的特征,在开发过程中不需要用户的参与.

blocks.en: A science museum wants to display dynamic structures formed by particles under mutual gravitational attraction. The exhibit must run continuously without frequent stalls when visitors move the camera, pause, or regenerate the cluster. Build a native interactive macOS application connecting computational correctness, GPU scheduling, and visual presentation. Research-grade astrophysical accuracy is unnecessary, but prerecorded video, regular rotation, or a small particle set cannot substitute for the specified interactions. The goal is a graphics implementation that can be repeatedly checked using common inputs, numerical comparisons, and device measurements.
blocks.zh: 一个科学博物馆希望在相互引力吸引下展示由粒子所形成的动态结构. 当访客移动相机、暂停或重新生成集群时,展览必须连续进行,不经常出现摊位。 构建本地交互macOS应用程序,连接计算正确性,GPU调度,和视觉演示. 研究级天体物理精度是不必要的,但预录视频,定期自转,或者一个小粒子集不能取代指定的相互作用. 目标是一个图形执行,可以使用通用输入,数字比较,设备测量等手段反复检查.

blocks.en: The display may begin with a simple small-particle state and then switch to a dense cluster. Both scales use the same computational definition; do not use a separate approximate simulation for the display. This sequence is a usage suggestion, not a requirement for a preset-scene library. Graphics optimization may change data organization and execution, but must preserve the physical meaning of exported results. Numerical checks compare short deterministic runs; long-term visual trajectory differences are not error thresholds. Choose the camera, particle colors, and background to make spatial structure clear.
blocks.zh: 显示可能从简单的小粒子状态开始,然后切换到密集的集群. 两个尺度都使用相同的计算定义;不要为显示使用单独的相近模拟. 这种序列是一种用法建议,而不是对预设场景库的要求. 图形优化可能改变数据组织和执行,但必须保留输出结果的物理含义. 数字检查比较了短的确定性运行;长期视轨差不是出错阈值. 选择相机,粒子颜色,和背景,使空间结构清晰.

blocks.en: Deliver an application that performs three-dimensional all-pairs gravitational computation and rendering with Metal, plus a terminal benchmark entry point. The program must load external state, advance with a fixed time step, export results, and measure performance. Establish small-scale correctness before optimizing to sixty frames per second on the specified device and particle count. Choose resource organization and scheduling yourself; evaluation uses correct output and measured frame times under the same workload.
blocks.zh: 交付一个执行三维全帕重力计算和与Metal一起渲染的应用程序,加上一个终端基准入站点. 程序必须加载外部状态,以固定的时间步骤推进,输出结果,并测量性能. 在指定的装置和粒子计数上,在优化到每秒60帧之前,确定小规模正确性。 自己选择资源组织和时间安排;评价使用正确的产出和在同一工作量下测量的框架时间。

blocks.en: The current directory is the project workspace prepared by Harbor inside Metal Sandbox. Keep source code, builds, and outputs in this writable directory, without relying on the host task-package path. Keep every candidate build and run inside the management service’s App Sandbox. Do not bypass restrictions through execution outside the sandbox, system services, elevated privileges, or host configuration changes.

blocks.en: The target is macOS on a physical Apple Silicon GPU. Use the actual clang, clang++, swift/swiftc, metal, and metallib resolved by the runtime PATH, together with the supplied CC, CXX, and SDKROOT. Check available tools and preserve the existing environment. System xcrun cannot run here; do not use it to locate tools or SDKs or assume an xcodebuild project is available. You may compile and link native frameworks directly, compile separate shaders with metal/metallib, or compile Metal source at runtime. Record missing tools honestly and do not install them on the host.

GUI operation, visible windows, screenshots, and presentation timing remain to be verified in this environment; retain the application and interactions. If restricted, report actual errors and unverified items rather than claiming an offscreen substitute is complete. Numerical commands must be independent of windows. The performance target is a Mac mini M4 and 32 GiB memory. Record the actual machine, system, tools, and available measurement capabilities. On unmatched hardware or without exclusive access, report exploratory results without claiming the target is met. Multiple-instance scheduling does not guarantee GPU exclusivity. Evaluators calibrate formal measurements under suitable conditions; application-reported metrics are not the sole evidence.

blocks.en: Deliver a native macOS project, README, and executable run.sh . Support ./run.sh app , ./run.sh simulate --input FILE --steps N --output FILE , and ./run.sh benchmark --input FILE --output DIR . The simulation entry point must operate without mouse interaction, read external files, and write parseable JSON. Report actual build logs on failure.

blocks.en: The input object contains dt , epsilon , and particles . Each particle is {id, mass, position:[x,y,z], velocity:[vx,vy,vz]} . IDs are unique signed 32-bit integers; mass lies in [ 0.001 , 10 ] [0.001,10] , absolute position components do not exceed 100, and absolute velocity components do not exceed 10. The ranges are d ​ t ∈ [ 0.0001 , 0.02 ] dt\in[0.0001,0.02] and e ​ p ​ s ​ i ​ l ​ o ​ n ∈ [ 0.05 , 1 ] epsilon\in[0.05,1] ; every number is finite. Support 2–8,192 particles. Invalid inputs or nonfinite computed values must produce a nonzero exit and an explanation.

blocks.en: All-pairs interaction and integration in every step must execute in Metal compute shaders; rendering must also use Metal. Do not substitute a CPU main loop, reduce the particles participating in interactions, cache fixed-input trajectories, or replace the formula with approximate neighborhood truncation. The CPU may handle input, UI, and resource management.
blocks.zh: 每一步骤中全帕相互作用和集成必须在金属计算阴影中执行;渲染也必须使用金属. 不要取而代之的是CPU主回路,减少参与交互的粒子,缓存固定输入轨迹,或者用近似相邻的截取来取而代之. CPU可能处理输入,UI,和资源管理.

blocks.en: Display every particle by default. Support mouse rotation, scroll-wheel zoom, and restoration of the default camera. Actual position updates drive the display. Particles may be points or small quads; complex materials are unnecessary. Camera changes must not change physical state, and window resizing must not stretch the coordinate space.
blocks.zh: 默认显示每个粒子 。 支持鼠标旋转,滚动轮缩放,并恢复默认相机. 实际位置更新驱动显示. 粒子可以是点或小四角;复杂的材料是不必要的. 相机变化不得改变物理状态,窗口再大小不得拉伸坐标空间.

blocks.en: Provide play/pause, single-step, reset, load, and current-state export controls, with the same export format as simulate. Show particle count and cumulative step count. Paused state remains unchanged; single-step advances exactly once; reset restores the most recently loaded initial state and zero steps. Interactive mode advances one fixed- d ​ t dt step per rendered frame, without adapting the step size to wall time.
blocks.zh: 提供播放/暂停、单步、重置、装入和当前状态的出口管制,其出口格式与模拟相同。 显示粒子计数和累积步骤计数 。 暂停状态不变;单步推进精确一次;重置恢复了最近加载的初始状态和零步. 交互模式将每个被制成的帧推进一个固定-d t dt步骤,而不会使步骤大小适应墙上时间.

blocks.en: The benchmark uses an evaluator-supplied state of 8,192 particles, d ​ t = 1 / 120 dt=1/120 , and e ​ p ​ s ​ i ​ l ​ o ​ n = 0.05 epsilon=0.05 . Render at 1920 × 1080 1920\times 1080 physical pixels. Each frame advances exactly one step and draws all particles. Dynamic resolution, skipped simulation steps, and reduced particle count are prohibited. Keep the camera fixed and the window visible during benchmarking.
blocks.zh: 该基准采用8,192个粒子的评价员提供状态,d t = 1/ 120 dt = 1/120,以及e s i o n = 0.05 epsilon = 0.05。 Render at 1920×1080 1920\times 1080 物理像素. 每个框架完全向前一步并绘制出所有粒子. 动态解析,跳过模拟步骤,并减少粒子计数被禁止. 在设定基准时保持相机和窗口的固定和可见性.

blocks.en: After a ten-second warmup, measure continuously for sixty seconds, with one task exclusively using the device and a 60 Hz display configuration. Average presented frame rate must be at least 59, presentation-interval p95 must not exceed 20 ms, and no stall may exceed 200 ms. This tolerance expresses a stable sixty-frame-per-second target; it does not require every frame to be strictly below 16.67 ms. Numerical correctness and workload checks must pass before performance is assessed.
blocks.zh: 经过10秒的热身后,连续测量60秒,其中一项任务完全使用该设备,60赫兹显示配置. 平均提交帧率必须至少为59,提交间隔p95不得超过20 ms,任何摊位都不得超过200 ms. 这种耐受性表示一个稳定的每秒六十六帧的目标;它并不要求每个帧严格低于16.67毫秒. 在评估业绩之前,必须进行数字正确性和工作量检查。

blocks.en: The benchmark exports per-frame submission, GPU completion, and actual presentation timestamps, step number, particle count, drawable size, and environment information. Explicitly mark unsupported timing fields as null and explain them. Do not pass off CPU submission time as GPU execution time. Trusted evaluation separately collects presentation evidence; application reports are not the only basis for assessment.
blocks.zh: 每个框架提交的基准出口、GPU的完成情况以及实际的列报时间戳、步骤数、颗粒计数、可取尺寸和环境信息。 明确标记无支持的定时字段为无效并解释. 不要将 CPU 提交时间作为 GPU 执行时间 。 可信评价单独收集列报证据;申请报告不是评估的唯一依据。

blocks.en: Load states with 2, 17, and 8,192 particles in sequence and switch between paused and running states ten times. There must be no out-of-bounds accesses, crashes, or stale-buffer artifacts. Preserve a usable interface and show a message on invalid input. Document self-test commands, known limitations, and one actual before/after optimization measurement in the README. Do not invent unexecuted results.
blocks.zh: 装入状态有2,17,和8,192个粒子序列,并在暂停状态和运行状态之间切换10次. 不得有出入境出入境,坠毁出入境,也不得有出入境出入境出入境出入境的出入境文物. 保存可用的界面并在无效输入上显示消息 。 在 README 中,文档自测试命令,已知限制,以及一个实际在优化前/之后的测量. 不要发明未执行的结果。

blocks.en: Use Swift, Objective-C, or C++ for host code and Metal Shading Language for GPU algorithms. Choose a native window framework. Do not substitute browser rendering, CUDA, external solver services, or video playback. Floating-point precision is your choice, but the specified error bounds must hold. Do not emit preset answers based on evaluation filenames.
blocks.zh: 使用Swift,Object-C,或C++用于主机代码和GPU算法的金属阴影语言. 选择本地窗口框架 。 不要替代浏览器渲染, CUDA, 外部解析器服务, 或视频回放 。 浮点精度是您的选择, 但指定的错误界限必须坚持 。 不发布基于评价文件名的预设答案 。

blocks.en: Collision merging, gravitational tree approximations, multiple GPUs, physical cosmological units, long-term orbital stability, model imports, and complex postprocessing are out of scope. A realistic-looking nebula does not replace formula verification. The same frame rate is not required on Linux or different Mac models.
blocks.zh: 碰撞并发,引力树相近,多GPU,物理宇宙单元,长期轨道稳定性,模型导入,和复杂的后处理都超出了范围. 一个现实外观的星云并不能取代公式验证. Linux或不同的Mac模型不需要相同的帧率.

blocks.en: The following are optional and do not affect the mandatory requirements: B1: Improve particle depth and background composition without reducing work. B2: Provide an analysis panel explaining numerical errors and measurements. B3: Improve camera reset, input feedback, and keyboard operation. B4: Explain a real bottleneck and evidence for its resolution.
blocks.zh: 下列是可选的,不影响强制性要求: B1:在不减少工作的情况下,改进粒子深度和背景组成. B2:提供一个分析面板来解释数值错误和测量。 B3:改进相机重置,输入反馈,和键盘操作. B4:解释其解决的真正瓶颈和证据.

blocks.en: Improve particle depth and background composition without reducing work.
blocks.zh: 改进粒子深度和背景组成,但不减少工作.

blocks.en: Provide an analysis panel explaining numerical errors and measurements.
blocks.zh: 提供分析面板,解释数字误差和测量。

blocks.en: Improve camera reset, input feedback, and keyboard operation.
blocks.zh: 改进相机重置,输入反馈,以及键盘操作.

blocks.en: Explain a real bottleneck and evidence for its resolution.
blocks.zh: 解释解决它的真正瓶颈和证据。

blocks.en: Choose thread organization, memory layout, buffer reuse, compute/render synchronization, particle shape, and colors. No particular technique is required, but explain what the exported timing metrics mean. If time is limited, prioritize small-scale numerical correctness and reproducible entry points. Extra visual effects must not reduce benchmark work.
blocks.zh: 选择线程组织,内存布局,缓冲再利用,计算/交付同步,粒子形状,和颜色. 不需要特殊技术,但解释出口的计时标准意味着什么。 如果时间有限,优先处理小规模数字正确性和可再生切入点。 额外的视觉效果绝不能减少基准工作.

blocks.en: Document the shortest steps from a clean directory to the main interface, including required configuration, default demonstration data, and reset behavior. Include source code, dependency versions, and required local resources; exclude credentials and personal information. Invalid input must produce understandable feedback rather than silently changing a previously correct state. Record only tests actually performed, explicitly identify unexecuted checks, and do not replace successful results with speculation. Prioritize first launch, normal use, boundary inputs, and quit/relaunch, and explain which limitations are unfinished work.
blocks.zh: 记录从一个干净的目录到主界面的最短步骤,包括所需的配置,默认演示数据,以及重置行为. 包括源代码,依赖性版本,以及需要的本地资源;不包括证书和个人信息. 无效输入必须产生可以理解的反馈,而不是默默地改变以前正确的状态. 只记录实际进行的测试,明确识别未执行的检查,不以投机取而代之. 优先安排首次发射,正常使用,边界输入,退出/再发射,并解释哪些限制是未完成的工作.
